shots.scene: 欣欣穿实验服戴护目镜，手举一张三乘三的彩色格子图，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot in a lab coat and safety goggles holds up a three by three grid colored green, yellow and red, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲化学实验室的风险评估。
overlay: 化学实验室的风险评估

shots.scene: 天平图标两端：警示三角和骰子
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale icon with a warning triangle on one pan and a dice on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 看危害有多重，也看发生有多大可能。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着一瓶带腐蚀象形图的试剂，犹豫不决
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a lab coat and goggles hesitates in front of a reagent bottle with a corrosion pictogram.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：这瓶酸很危险，还能用吗？

shots.scene: 小研拿着空白评估表走过来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over holding a blank assessment form and a pen.
shots.narration: 小研说：危险不等于不能用，先评估。

shots.scene: 欣欣在三乘三格子图前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a large three by three colored grid and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 评估好风险，才知道该怎么做。

shots.section_title: 防护装备按风险评估来选
shots.scene: 王老师对照空白评估表，给学生分发护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a blank assessment form and hands out safety goggles and gloves to students.
shots.narration: 穿戴什么防护，也是评估出来的。
overlay: 防护装备按风险评估来选

shots.section_title: 防护装备按风险评估来选
shots.scene: 撤空试剂的讲解台
shots.prompt_en: A clean demonstration bench with no reagent bottles, a blank whiteboard behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 讲解台上的化学品已经全部撤走。

shots.section_title: 化学品和仪器的固有危害
shots.scene: 试剂架上一排试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: A shelf of reagent bottles with blank labels in a teaching lab. No people.
shots.narration: 科学进步，离不开化学品。
overlay: 化学品和仪器的固有危害

shots.section_title: 化学品和仪器的固有危害
shots.scene: 四个象形图：腐蚀、骷髅、爆炸、火焰
shots.prompt_en: Four red-bordered diamond pictograms in a row: corrosion, skull, exploding bomb, and flame. No people.
shots.narration: 它们可能有腐蚀性、毒性、反应性、易燃性。

shots.section_title: 化学品和仪器的固有危害
shots.scene: 加热板和带压装置图标，旁有警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a hot plate with heat waves and a sealed vessel with a pressure gauge, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 用仪器也有风险，尤其高温加压时。

shots.scene: 四个图标中第二个天平亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row; the second one, a balance scale, lights up brightly. No people.
shots.narration: 评估风险，是四步中的第二步。

shots.scene: 实验室里几个人各自操作，一个盾牌罩住所有人
shots.prompt_en: Several students work at benches in a lab while a large transparent shield icon covers all of them.
shots.narration: 管好风险，保护你，也保护身边每个人。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着放大镜图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a magnifying glass icon with a green check mark.
shots.narration: 这一课假定危害已经识别出来。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a yellow warning triangle.
shots.narration: 危害，是可能造成伤害的来源。

shots.scene: 一小滴燃料和一大桶燃料，都带火焰象形图
shots.prompt_en: A single small drop of fuel and a large fuel can, both marked with the same flame pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品的危害是它固有的。

shots.scene: 两个火焰象形图之间等号
shots.prompt_en: Two identical flame pictograms with an equals sign between them, one small and one large. No people.
shots.narration: 一滴汽油和一桶汽油，一样易燃。

shots.scene: 公式图标：警示三角乘骰子等于风险表
shots.prompt_en: An icon equation: a warning triangle times a dice equals a gauge meter. No people.
shots.narration: 风险等于严重程度乘以发生可能性。

shots.scene: 空白坐标轴，纵轴三格，横轴三格
shots.prompt_en: A blank chart with a vertical axis and a horizontal axis, each divided into three marks. No people.
shots.narration: 常用风险矩阵来表示。

shots.scene: 纵轴三格依次亮起低中高
shots.prompt_en: The three marks on the vertical axis light up from bottom to top in green, yellow and red. No people.
shots.narration: 严重程度，分低、中、高。

shots.scene: 横轴三格依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The three marks on the horizontal axis light up from left to right in green, yellow and red. No people.
shots.narration: 可能性，也分低、中、高。

shots.scene: 矩阵填满绿黄红渐变
shots.prompt_en: The grid fills with a gradient from green at the bottom left to red at the top right. No people.
shots.narration: 越往右上角，风险越高。

shots.scene: 老周熟练地组装装置，阿杰在旁边手忙脚乱
shots.prompt_en: The older man calmly assembles glassware on a stand while the young male student beside him fumbles with a clamp.
shots.narration: 评估风险，有一定主观性。

shots.scene: 同一操作，老手打绿勾，新手旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: Two person pictograms doing the same task; the experienced one has a green check, the novice has a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 老手稳稳当当，新手却可能出错。

shots.scene: 晴天草地上，阿杰在两棵树之间散步
shots.prompt_en: On a sunny day, the young male student walks on a green lawn between two trees under a clear blue sky.
shots.narration: 闪电是已知的危害。

shots.scene: 晴天的闪电图标，风险表指向低
shots.prompt_en: A lightning bolt icon faded under a sun icon, with a gauge meter pointing low. No people.
shots.narration: 可晴天被雷击，风险非常低。

shots.scene: 雷雨天，阿杰走进室内
shots.prompt_en: On a stormy day with dark clouds, the young male student walks into a building through the door.
shots.narration: 雷雨天，待在室内就能降低风险。

shots.scene: 人站在大树和旗杆下的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a person standing under a tall tree and next to a flagpole in a storm, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 在户外，要远离大树、旗杆等高处。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a lab bench and nods.
shots.narration: 实验室里也是同样的道理。

shots.scene: 风险表指针随着护目镜、手套、通风橱图标出现而下降
shots.prompt_en: A gauge meter needle drops as icons of goggles, gloves and a fume hood appear one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 做好基本防护，就能降低受伤风险。

shots.section_title: 案例一：往滴定管里倒强酸
shots.scene: 铁架台上的滴定管，旁边一瓶带腐蚀象形图的溶液
shots.prompt_en: A burette clamped on a ring stand next to a bottle with a corrosion pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 案例一：把强酸溶液倒进滴定管。
overlay: 案例一：往滴定管里倒强酸

shots.section_title: 案例一：往滴定管里倒强酸
shots.scene: 举过头顶向高处漏斗倒液的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person raising a beaker above eye level to pour into a high funnel, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 举过头顶往上倒，最容易洒。

shots.section_title: 案例一：往滴定管里倒强酸
shots.scene: 矩阵中严重程度一格亮起中高
shots.prompt_en: The risk grid with the severity axis highlighted at medium and high. No people.
shots.narration: 严重程度，按浓度为中或高。

shots.section_title: 案例一：往滴定管里倒强酸
shots.scene: 器皿和手的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a wide beaker and a shaky hand beside a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 洒不洒，看用什么器皿、手稳不稳。

shots.section_title: 案例一：往滴定管里倒强酸
shots.scene: 矩阵中一个点落在中高区，变成橙红色
shots.prompt_en: A dot placed on the risk grid in the medium-high area, glowing orange red. No people.
shots.narration: 合起来是中到高风险，要改进做法。

shots.scene: 小研把滴定管取下放低，用漏斗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves lowers the burette below eye level and places a small funnel in it.
shots.narration: 用漏斗，把滴定管放低再加液。

shots.scene: 小研用小烧杯在托盘上倾倒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours from a small beaker over a plastic tray.
shots.narration: 用小烧杯倒，洒的可能就小了。

shots.scene: 护目镜和手套图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of safety goggles and gloves with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 再戴好护目镜和手套，减少暴露。

shots.scene: 矩阵中的点从橙红区移到绿区
shots.prompt_en: The dot on the risk grid moves from the orange red area down to the green area. No people.
shots.narration: 风险就降下来了。

shots.scene: 一瓶带腐蚀象形图的浓酸和一只装水的烧杯
shots.prompt_en: A bottle with a corrosion pictogram and a blank label next to a beaker of water. No people.
shots.narration: 案例二：稀释浓硫酸。

shots.scene: 腐蚀象形图指向眼睛和手的图标
shots.prompt_en: A corrosion pictogram with arrows to an eye icon and a hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它会腐蚀皮肤和眼睛，严重程度高。

shots.scene: 矩阵中的点落在上方中间
shots.prompt_en: A dot placed high on the severity axis and in the middle of the likelihood axis on the risk grid. No people.
shots.narration: 可能性为中，总体是中到高风险。

shots.scene: 小研戴好护目镜和耐酸手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on safety goggles and thick acid-resistant gloves.
shots.narration: 戴护目镜和耐酸手套，减少暴露。

shots.scene: 欣欣突然举手示意停下
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot suddenly raises a paw to signal stop.
shots.narration: 等等，还有一个危害没识别出来！

shots.scene: 温度计图标飙升，旁边热浪
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon with the red column shooting up and heat waves around it. No people.
shots.narration: 浓酸遇水，会放出大量的热。

shots.scene: 往酸里倒水的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of water being poured into a container of acid with splashes flying out, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 把水倒进浓酸里，容易飞溅。

shots.scene: 酸缓缓流入水中、玻璃棒搅拌的图标，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of acid flowing slowly into a beaker of water while a glass rod stirs, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 应把酸慢慢加入水中，边加边搅。

shots.scene: 清单回头打勾
shots.prompt_en: A checklist with an arrow looping back to the top and an extra line being added. No people.
shots.narration: 评估时，要回头查有没有漏掉危害。

shots.section_title: 难点一：严重程度难判断
shots.scene: 欣欣挠头，旁边三张空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot scratches its head beside three blank cards.
shots.narration: 评估风险，说起来容易做起来难。
overlay: 难点一：严重程度难判断

shots.section_title: 难点一：严重程度难判断
shots.scene: 警示三角好认，旁边刻度尺带问号
shots.prompt_en: A warning triangle icon with a green check next to a measuring scale icon with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 危害好认，严重程度却难判断。

shots.section_title: 难点一：严重程度难判断
shots.scene: 三张卡片：骷髅、时钟、火焰
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards with icons: a skull, a clock, and a flame thermometer. No people.
shots.narration: 要看懂毒性、接触限值和闪点。

shots.section_title: 难点一：严重程度难判断
shots.scene: 老周在给小研讲解数据
shots.prompt_en: The older man explains a blank data sheet to the female graduate student, pointing at a line.
shots.narration: 这些往往要靠技能和经验来判断。

shots.section_title: 难点二：经验决定可能性
shots.scene: 一条成长阶梯，从新手到熟练
shots.prompt_en: A staircase icon with a small sprout at the bottom step and a tree at the top step. No people.
shots.narration: 暴露的可能性，取决于你的经验。
overlay: 难点二：经验决定可能性

shots.section_title: 难点二：经验决定可能性
shots.scene: 阿杰从刚入学到毕业的两个样子
shots.prompt_en: Split image: the young male student nervously holding a beaker as a freshman, and confidently working at a bench later.
shots.narration: 刚上大学几乎为零，毕业时已很熟练。

shots.section_title: 难点三：多大风险可接受
shots.scene: 两个人看同一个风险表，一个点头一个摇头
shots.prompt_en: Two person pictograms look at the same gauge meter; one nods with a check, the other shakes head with a cross. No people.
shots.narration: 多大的风险可以接受？
overlay: 难点三：多大风险可接受

shots.section_title: 难点三：多大风险可接受
shots.scene: 风险表指针停在低区，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: A gauge meter with the needle in the green low zone and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 一般要降到低，但各人判断不同。

shots.section_title: 难点三：多大风险可接受
shots.scene: 判断不同，选的措施也不同
shots.prompt_en: Two different sets of protection icons branching from the same gauge meter. No people.
shots.narration: 判断不同，采取的措施也会不同。

shots.section_title: 评估风险是你将来的责任
shots.scene: 实验课讲义上已打勾的步骤
shots.prompt_en: A blank lab manual open with pre-checked steps and a green shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 普通化学课的实验，大多已设计好。
overlay: 评估风险是你将来的责任

shots.section_title: 评估风险是你将来的责任
shots.scene: 小研独立设计实验，填写评估表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student designs her own experiment at a desk, filling in a blank assessment form.
shots.narration: 将来做科研，评估风险就是你的责任。

shots.section_title: 评估风险是你将来的责任
shots.scene: 欣欣给阿杰一个加油的手势
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives the young male student an encouraging thumbs up.
shots.narration: 从现在起，就练好这项本领。

shots.section_title: 评估风险在四步中的位置
shots.scene: 四个图标，第二个天平高亮
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row with the second one, a balance scale, highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 评估风险，承上启下。
overlay: 评估风险在四步中的位置

shots.section_title: 评估风险在四步中的位置
shots.scene: 欣欣翻开空白课程目录
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a blank course booklet with numbered tabs.
shots.narration: 降低风险和应急准备，后面再讲。

shots.section_title: 实验前书面评估与审批
shots.scene: 小研在空白评估表上逐项填写
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills in a blank risk assessment form, ticking boxes for hazards and measures.
shots.narration: 做新实验，先写书面风险评估。
overlay: 实验前书面评估与审批

shots.section_title: 实验前书面评估与审批
shots.scene: 老周和王老师先后在表上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs the form, then the safety administrator signs below.
shots.narration: 导师和实验室负责人审核批准再做。

shots.section_title: 实验前书面评估与审批
shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三层金字塔，高风险一格亮红
shots.prompt_en: A three-level pyramid icon of campus, department and lab, with a red warning light on the top level. No people.
shots.narration: 高风险实验，按本校规定逐级报备。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶变大、温度计上升、换人三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a bottle growing larger, a thermometer rising, and a swap arrow between two person pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 换试剂、加量、升温、换人，

shots.scene: 评估表上的循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A blank assessment form with a circular refresh arrow on it. No people.
shots.narration: 条件一变，就要重新评估。

shots.section_title: 新手先培训、在指导下做
shots.scene: 阿杰在培训室参加考试，拿到空白合格证
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finishes a test in a training room and receives a blank certificate.
shots.narration: 新手先参加安全培训，考核合格。
overlay: 新手先培训、在指导下做

shots.section_title: 新手先培训、在指导下做
shots.scene: 老周站在阿杰身边指导操作
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands beside the young male student and guides his hands as he sets up glassware.
shots.narration: 第一次做，要在老师指导下操作。

shots.scene: 一个人独自在夜里实验室的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a single person working alone in a dark lab at night, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 危险实验，不能一个人独自做。

shots.scene: 小研操作，阿杰在旁边看护
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works at a fume hood while the young male student stands nearby watching attentively.
shots.narration: 要有人在场，出事能及时帮忙。

shots.scene: 阿杰手背被溅到，立即冲到水龙头下冲洗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student gets a splash on the back of his gloved hand and immediately rinses it under a running lab faucet.
shots.narration: 酸溅到皮肤，马上用大量流水冲洗。

shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign above a lab eyewash station with water flowing. No people.
shots.narration: 溅进眼睛，立即到洗眼器冲洗。

shots.scene: 紧急喷淋标志
shots.prompt_en: An emergency shower sign above a safety shower in a lab corner. No people.
shots.narration: 大面积沾染，用紧急喷淋。

shots.scene: 电话图标和红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 报告负责人，需要时拨打120。

shots.section_title: 拿不准就问，不擅改方案
shots.scene: 阿杰举手向老周提问
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to ask the older man a question.
shots.narration: 拿不准的地方，先问老师。
overlay: 拿不准就问，不擅改方案

shots.section_title: 拿不准就问，不擅改方案
shots.scene: 被擅自改写的实验步骤单打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure sheet with scribbled changes crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不擅自改变实验方案。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在风险矩阵旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the colored risk grid.
shots.narration: 危害是固有的，风险可以管。

shots.scene: 公式图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon equation: a warning triangle times a dice equals a gauge meter. No people.
shots.narration: 风险看严重程度，也看发生可能。

shots.scene: 漏斗、小烧杯、酸入水三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a funnel in a lowered burette, a small beaker over a tray, and acid flowing into water. No people.
shots.narration: 改进做法，别漏掉隐藏的危害。

shots.scene: 评估表、签字笔和循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank assessment form, a signature pen and a refresh arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 先评估再审批，条件变了再评估。
